mappingNotes: ComponentMap export nodes end _Background-Glossy or _Background; strip suffix to resolve authored live container. Native tree still needs inspection because this is export-time mapping.
Prefer group 05 art for approved movement and team controls; group 03 alternatives have older per-node dimensions and should not be layered behind group 05.
Use group 01 fixed art for matching panel proportions. If target aspect differs, preserve authored target size and use group 07 panel skin instead of stretching.
Use one group 02 ItemCard template and clone its blank slots. Delete generated pet/item content rather than populating placeholder products, names or prices.
Group 04 tracks and fills are separate full-width assets; meter percentage comes from clipping/scripted fill data, never baked example progress.
Group 06 has 3 colour variants. Reuse each asset for all matching game cards, changing native TextLabel content and game data.
Group 07 has 11 themes times 3 states. Ten disabled theme images are byte-identical; panel-disabled is distinct.
Skip Optional-Labelled-Buttons to keep every caption native and editable.
Keep native text over art, with outward dark stroke, and preserve authored layout. Do not rasterize labels.
The nested PlaygroundClassics-CleanImport-20261004 copy is identical for every PNG. Use user-mentioned top-level folder only.
Pressed/disabled nine-slice art intentionally has maximum alpha below 255. Keep ImageTransparency at zero unless applying an additional deliberate fade.
coverageGaps: BritishBulldogHUD TopCard, RolePill, Results, Departure and other non-movement panels are absent from ComponentMap; map suitable reusable group 07 theme.
Leaderboard artwork is explicitly deferred by the user; do not reskin leaderboard SurfaceGuis in this pass.
Group 05, group 06 and group 07 need semantic overrides; these assets are not assigned by old ComponentMap.
Supplied icon and backplate attachments are outside this clean pack; inventory/import separately.
No Roblox upload IDs exist in this clean pack manifest. New assets require upload or native image-ID reconciliation; historical icon IDs are not substitutes.

historicalIconIDs.note: Old artwork only; do not mistake these for new clean-pack assets.
